text: The baby comes at home, through the night. Fetching wood at dusk, the young man counts twelve faces at the fences. A boy is born at dawn, and on the Macedonian side a queue of sleepy faces looks up and cheers. He begins to weep. The twentieth century novel, he realises, had not prepared him for this.
